acute-phase protein synthesis, hypermetabolism, increased

and norepinephrine are secreted during the stress response 
in order to mobilize nutrient stores to meet the immedi-
ate energy demand. Gluconeogenesis, glycogenolysis, and 
lipolysis occur as the body attempts to increase available
glucose. Th e increased rate of gluconeogenesis creates 
reliance on protein as a source of glucose, which causes
increased catabolism of skeletal muscle.
